C-SUPERSEDE-RECORD.IntentSummary: Make ngrace supersede fold any open epoch before it archives, so a discarded bundle keeps its Epoch, attempts, and signatures. Range-close with kind discarded, never terminal. discarded is unreachable except through discardAndFoldEpoch; advanceCursor refuses it and the CLI inherits that refuse by forwarding. Document that the verb discards governance, never code. No new src file. Ceremony T2. Sequential tasks T-001 then T-002 then T-003 then T-004 then T-005. Red budgets: at most three distinct signatureKeys per task, never the same key twice, exact kind-plus-key equality. Record fail in its own tool round trip, then edit, then pass. Close split: the executor opens an epoch, marks progress, and records attempts; the authority owns the range-closing event, cursor fold, ngrace review, gate verdict, gate apply, gate archive, writing status applied, and moving the bundle. Do not put a current-mode lint of this project root in TargetAssertions or in post-write task Verification. Do not require bun run validate:ci or bun run validate:teaching-surface. Report a scope breach before making a write outside ObservedWriteScope.

MustContain.Text: A used allocation range has no terminal event, so the worker may have died mid-flight.
Emit a terminal event for each used range before fold.
Write superseded onto an active change bundle, name its replacement, and move it into archive.
Write superseded onto the active spec and plan when present, name the replacement, and move the bundle into archive. The replacement directory must already exist
Run `ngrace supersede` instead of editing an approved conflict in place.
kind "discarded" is reserved; ngrace supersede writes it when abandoning an open epoch.
